scope: Supabase Studio for one environment on a running installation: started on demand through the management API, entered with the console ticket on its own origin, and used through Studio's own API for tables, SQL, users and buckets; refused without the session or with another environment's session; stopped. Transcribed from the CI docker-install job 107473260995 (run 35948924152, commit 19fd36d) on a clean GitHub runner; not a real server.

checks.check: operator logs in
a provisioned environment exists
Studio is stopped until someone asks for it
opening before it runs is refused
an owner starts Studio
the supervisor starts Studio and postgres-meta
the console issues a one-minute ticket
the environment has its own Studio origin
Studio refuses a browser without the session
Studio refuses a forged session
the ticket opens a session for this origin only
Studio answers behind the session
the project page loads
the table list reads the environment database
the SQL editor sees the environment users despite row security
the SQL editor creates a table and a row
Studio creates a user through the environment Auth
Studio lists the environment buckets through Storage
the session does not open another environment
the owner stops Studio
Studio is stopped again
a stopped Studio is not reachable with the old session
